pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: Gunner sittin' pretty on top, but Devin's breathin' down his neck like a squirrel on a pecan tree. Zach's gotta be feelin' like Mustard Boy out here after that 3-0 Spain beatdown on his precious Austria — he drafted Saudi Arabia hopin' they'd strike oil on the pitch, but so far they're just drillin' empty wells. Gayden, a.k.a. The Backpass Assassin, actually thought Jordan was his secret weapon — they can't even find the net with Google Maps. Meanwhile, Rafe, The Noisemaker, is tryin' to play fantasy soccer when he should be studyin' for his learner's permit — he didn't even know three of his teams weren't at the World Cup. This race ain't over, but Rafe better hope Uzbekistan's got magic boots.

pundit_takes.headline: Mustard Boy Zach tanks Austria as Spain cruises 3-0
pundit_takes.subtitle: Zach blames Austria's poor showing on lack of spicy mustard.

pundit_takes.headline: Backpass Assassin Gayden stays third despite England's Tier 1 status
pundit_takes.subtitle: Gayden's England pick shows even the best ideas can underperform.

pundit_takes.headline: Ghost Pepper Devin spicy with Spain, leaves Mustard Boy in tears
pundit_takes.subtitle: Devin's 3-0 success over Zach proves variety is the spice of life.

pundit_takes.headline: Noisemaker Rafe holds last place with unqualified soccer knowledge
pundit_takes.subtitle: Rafe's draft strategy inspired by a shuffle of random soccer teams.

rome_analytics_quotes: Rafe's chaos reigns with Germany exiting early, keeping the league unpredictable.
Rafe's Tier-3 mess shines with Mexico scoring 14 points, defying expectations.
Gunner stomps Devin with an 8-point differential; the ghost got ghosted.
Sim bowled a gutter ball letting Rafe be more than a 1% joke.
